Intetics Inc. , a global technology company providing custom software application development, distributed professional teams, software product quality assessment, and "all-things-digital" solutions, is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior AI-Augmented Software Engineer to join our dynamic team.
The client is a leading company specializing in advanced cybersecurity solutions. They provide comprehensive security measures designed to protect sensitive data and systems from cyber threats. Their offerings include vulnerability management, threat intelligence, incident response, and compliance management. With cutting-edge technology and a team of experts, they ensure robust protection for organizations across various industries, helping clients stay ahead of evolving cyber threats and maintain a secure digital environment.
This role is for engineers who use AI agents as an integral part of their daily development workflow, not just as coding assistants. We are looking for someone experienced with AI-powered tooling, agentic workflows, and coding harnesses who can significantly accelerate delivery while maintaining high engineering standards.
This is not a "vibe coding" role. The successful candidate must be able to critically evaluate AI-generated solutions, make sound technical decisions, and take full ownership of the result.
 Requirements
7+ years of software engineering experience
Strong PHP and/or Python expertise
Extensive practical use of AI agents in software development
Ability to review, validate, and improve AI-generated code
Strong software design, debugging, and problem-solving skills
Ownership mindset and accountability for delivered solutions
 Nice to Have
Experience with both PHP and Python
Technical leadership or mentoring experience
Architecture and solution design experience
Background in cybersecurity, vulnerability management, or risk management
